research.job_description_summary: Deloitte hires Analyst Trainees in India for its US-India (USI) technology practice. Three 2026 Glassdoor India reviews (May to July) describe shortlisting through the National Level Assessment, an online assessment, and an interview of about 40 to 45 minutes covering self-introduction, OS (deadlock), DBMS, simple coding (count alphabets and digits), basic programming and project discussion. A February 2026 JobRise guide (no verifiable sources) adds a Versant spoken English test, aptitude, DSA, system design, cloud and SQL topics and HR questions. The official careers page was not fetched.
limitations: Deloitte's official careers page was not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED.
Candidate-attributed material is three 2026 Glassdoor India reviews for Analyst Trainee; they give topics and a few questions without exact text, so class B items are paraphrases with low confidence.
The JobRise guide (2026-02-11) cites no verifiable candidate sources; its lists are used as class D topic context.
The Versant test is automated and audio-based; its items are not public, so the spoken-English prompts are practice proxies.
Aptitude, verbal and logical questions are original practice; the actual online assessment content was not found.
Consulting and case-study tracks were not modelled; only the USI technology Analyst track is covered.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
Source pages on LeetCode Discuss and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403 to the CodeArena audit tool (2026-10-11), so the cited questions were not re-confirmed against those pages.
